_note: The malformed shapes the BIP-174 parser must refuse. Each invalid case names the rule it breaks, and its bytes were assembled for this suite so it fails on that rule and not on an unrelated decode error.

invalid.name: the magic is not psbt
invalid.reason: every psbt starts with the five bytes 70736274ff

invalid.name: truncated in the middle of a key-value pair
invalid.reason: a map that does not reach its separator is malformed

invalid.name: the unsigned transaction carries a script sig
invalid.reason: the global unsigned transaction must have every input script empty

invalid.name: no global unsigned transaction
invalid.reason: version zero requires the unsigned transaction key

invalid.name: the global unsigned transaction key appears twice
invalid.reason: a key may appear at most once in a map

invalid.name: the global map is empty
invalid.reason: version zero requires the unsigned transaction key
